description: eval_header_test has special logic to populate capture variables when mt == MatchType::Matches and variables_enabled is true (the pending_captures pattern). eval_address_test uses apply_match directly with no capture-variable population. RFC 5229 §4 requires that numbered variables (dollar{1}, dollar{2}, ...) be set by any test that uses :matches, not just header. A Sieve script using 'address :matches' expects capture variables to be populated, but they will not be. This is a conformance gap with RFC 5229.
title: sieve: address test does not capture variables on :matches; only header test does
